 Over het werk 
As a technical employee, you are responsible for inspecting, maintaining, and preparing containers that are used daily for transport. You will work full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, in a dynamic and hands-on environment. Do you want to use your technical and practical skills in a challenging and varied role?
